//: Whether each ingest plugin step has been replayed byte for byte through its plugin (intake parity: the old command line against plugin + intake stage --write, same inputs, same frozen clock). Every step that does not fetch must be listed: `proved` names where the run is recorded (the landing note of the refactor stream that ran it: rf-ingest, r2-ingest, refactor-ingest-api; or the test that replays it); `blocked` says why it cannot be replayed on this machine and what would unblock it. A network step is listed only once it has been proved offline (intake parity --offline: the network closed, the step replaying its own cache). tests/intake/ingest-plugins.test.mjs holds the list complete; intake plugins prints it.
